items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: At that time, he was Liberace’s attorney... He handled Liberace’s stuff, his estate in Los Vegas

ctx.x: Yeah. It cost me a pretty penny, but I got it back, and he’s still my attorney. At that time, he was Liberace’s attorney. So he knew the business. He’s still my attorney and we . . .
